# Vistance Networks

On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment,
which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining Company was
renamed to Vistance Networks.  

Learn more

##  Meet the solution that drives innovation 

Explore the industry-leading brand that delivers trusted connectivity solutions across enterprises,
service providers, and industrial environments. 

[Aurora Networks]

## Aurora Networks™

Aurora Networks is the world’s leading provider of access network solutions. Our comprehensive,
end-to-end product portfolio supports global service providers with innovative, leading-edge HFC,
PON and broadband network products.

[Learn more][155]

## Aurora Networks™ Solutions


Aurora Networks is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end access network solutions that
support global service providers with high-quality next-generation architectures. From
high-performance networking to scalable infrastructure, we help organizations connect, grow and
adapt in an ever-evolving digital world. Learn more about our Solution offering and what
technologies we can offer.

Vistance Networks (NASDAQ: VISN), a global provider of intelligent network solutions, announced

## Market-defining technologies driving the future of AI

Cisco IQ
[Cisco Cloud Control software screenshot]

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

## Powering outcomes you need to thrive in the AI era

### AI-ready data centers

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,
scale, and flexibility.

[Glowing translucent cubes with internal circuitry connected by blue light beams.]

### Future-proofed workplaces

Create agile, resilient workplaces that evolve with employee needs and deliver incredible customer
experiences everywhere.

[Transparent cube containing a miniature night city with glowing skyscrapers and highways.]

### Digital resilience

Keep your organization securely up and running in the face of any disruption—from cyberattacks to
third-party outages and other technical failures.

LatestFinalWire Unveils AIDA64 v8.3028/04/2026
The latest AIDA64 update introduces AIDA FPS, a new module that captures real-time frame rate data
in DirectX 11 and 12 games. It also adds support for Adaptec RAID controllers and the latest
Turing-based external displays, along with expanded support for the newest graphics and GPGPU
technologies from AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA.
[Read more ][13]
Testimonials
[ Corsair logo]As leading developers of computing hardware for enthusiasts, we spend countless hours
in the lab evaluating the performance and compatibility of our latest memory, storage, and cooling
products. We have found that AIDA64 is an ideal tool for comprehensively evaluating new hardware in
the 64-bit Windows 7 environment that our customers favor. We have used AIDA and Everest tools for
many years, and see this partnership continuing well into the future.
John BeekleyVice President / Corsair

>

# **Smarter Digital Signage. Proven IP Video**

## Amino powers high-performance content delivery at scale, using platforms that are simple to run,
## durable in the field and always in control.

Why Amino

## Securely delivered, reliably managed and fully supported.

Pioneers in IP Video Delivery

With 25+ years at the forefront of IP video technology, Amino delivers trusted, broadcast-grade
performance across signage, enterprise and Pay TV markets. Our hardware, cloud platforms and partner
ecosystem help customers stay ahead in a fast-moving media landscape - anywhere - at scale.

Performance That Scales. Reliability You Can Trust.

Every day, millions of Amino-powered screens securely deliver lowest-latency video to businesses
across all sectors, from live betting venues to corporate campuses. Built for 24/7 operation and
zero-downtime environments, our solutions combine rugged hardware with remote management that just
works.

Remote Management; Simple & Sustainable

Amino’s remote management platforms offer full remote control over deployed devices, from firmware
to content delivery. Whether managing thousands of screens or pushing a quick update across sites,
operators can do it all from a single, cloud-based interface: no downtime to damage your business
and no truck rolls to harm the planet.

Support That Sets Us Apart

From initial deployment to daily operation, Amino’s award-winning global support team is on hand
24/7. We deliver more than a break/fix solution, we help you optimize, scale and solve challenges
fast. Choose from flexible support tiers, with direct access to engineers who understand
mission-critical video environments.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What sizes of rigid boxes does your company offer?

At AnyRigidBox, we can help you find the right size for whatever needs to be shipped or stored. We
provide an extensive selection of packaging solutions, ranging from small to large, to ensure all
your items are securely stored or shipped. Let us help you find the correct size box today.

### Can my logo, artwork, or design be printed on rigid boxes?

Yes, you most certainly can! Here at AnyRigidBox, we provide top-tier printing services that allow
you to personalize your rigid boxes with logos, artwork, and your chosen designs. Our
state-of-the-art printing technology is perfect for creating stunning and eye-catching prints to
make your custom packaging stand out.

### Can I order just one rigid box?

At AnyRigidBox, we understand that sometimes you need smaller orders of rigid packaging solutions.
That is why we are pleased to offer you precisely what you need, whenever you require it, in the
quantity that meets your needs.

### Which finishing option will make my rigid box look the most vibrant and eye-catching?

Adding a gloss laminated finish to your rigid box will give it a shiny look that will stand out. The
gloss finish will make the colors in your design pop, creating a fantastic effect that will draw the
eye.

### What is the difference between offset, digital, and screen printing?

At AnyRigidBox, we are confident that these printing methods offer distinct benefits and are perfect
for particular projects. Offset printing is outstanding for larger prints, using a metal plate to
transfer an inked image onto paper. Digital printing is the ideal option for quick turnarounds and
small print runs, as it involves an inkjet device that directly applies ink onto a surface. Lastly,
screen printing is the ideal choice for producing large quantities of uniform prints with bright
colors, as this technique involves pressing ink through a fine mesh onto a surface.

### What is the fastest estimated delivery time for my order?

If you need your boxes quickly, we offer a rush process to deliver them in 6-8 business days.
Otherwise, our standard turnaround time is 8-10 business days.

### What payment methods do you accept?

At AnyRigidBox, we make it easy and convenient for you to get our premium products by accepting
various payment methods - Debit/Credit Cards, PayPal - and for large purchases, you can even pay
directly via bank transfer or check.

### Can I get a sample before I place an order?

Yes, absolutely! Here at AnyRigidBox, we understand your need to feel the product to gain confidence
in your purchase. If you would like to, you can ask for a sample of one of our custom-made boxes or
your own printed box to examine the quality.

### What sizes of rigid boxes does your company offer?

At AnyRigidBox, we can help you find the right size for whatever needs to be shipped or stored. We
provide an extensive selection of packaging solutions, ranging from small to large, to ensure all
your items are securely stored or shipped. Let us help you find the correct size box today.

### Can my logo, artwork, or design be printed on rigid boxes?

Yes, you most certainly can! Here at AnyRigidBox, we provide top-tier printing services that allow
you to personalize your rigid boxes with logos, artwork, and your chosen designs. Our
state-of-the-art printing technology is perfect for creating stunning and eye-catching prints to
make your custom packaging stand out.

### Can I order just one rigid box?

At AnyRigidBox, we understand that sometimes you need smaller orders of rigid packaging solutions.
That is why we are pleased to offer you precisely what you need, whenever you require it, in the
quantity that meets your needs.

### Which finishing option will make my rigid box look the most vibrant and eye-catching?

Adding a gloss laminated finish to your rigid box will give it a shiny look that will stand out. The
gloss finish will make the colors in your design pop, creating a fantastic effect that will draw the
eye.

### What is the difference between offset, digital, and screen printing?

At AnyRigidBox, we are confident that these printing methods offer distinct benefits and are perfect
for particular projects. Offset printing is outstanding for larger prints, using a metal plate to
transfer an inked image onto paper. Digital printing is the ideal option for quick turnarounds and
small print runs, as it involves an inkjet device that directly applies ink onto a surface. Lastly,
screen printing is the ideal choice for producing large quantities of uniform prints with bright
colors, as this technique involves pressing ink through a fine mesh onto a surface.

various payment methods - Debit/Credit Cards, PayPal - and for large purchases, you can even pay
directly via bank transfer or check.

in your purchase. If you would like to, you can ask for a sample of one of our custom-made boxes or
your own printed box to examine the quality.

## A Practice Built
## for Cross-Border Complexity.

Founded in Dubai in 2020, Avyanco was built on a single conviction: that the world's most ambitious
founders deserve an advisor who can guide them across every market, not just one.

Unlike providers built to sell a single licence, we begin with your business — model, tax exposure,
ownership and expansion plans — then recommend the jurisdiction and structure that fit. Our
integrated practice delivers it end-to-end: formation, corporate structuring, tax, audit, compliance
and operational support under one partnership.

We serve founders raising capital in London, family offices structuring across the GCC, and
multinationals expanding into Saudi Arabia — across our eleven jurisdictions. We remain independent,
partner-led and accountable to our clients, so every recommendation follows commercial logic, never
a sales target.

A structured six-step engagement — transparent at every stage, partner-supervised throughout.

### Initial Consultation

A partner-led call to understand your business model, target markets, and ownership objectives — no
obligation, no junior intake.

02

### Structure & Jurisdiction

Our partners recommend the optimal jurisdiction and legal structure — mainland, free zone, or
offshore — based on your commercial and tax position.

03

### Document Preparation

Every required document prepared: memoranda of association, shareholder agreements, notarisations,
attestations, and certified translations.

Applications submitted directly to the relevant authority — DET, DMCC, ADGM, DIFC, or any of the 45+

## A Practice Built
## for Cross-Border Complexity.

Founded in Dubai in 2020, Avyanco was built on a single conviction: that the world's most ambitious
founders deserve an advisor who can guide them across every market, not just one.

Unlike providers built to sell a single licence, we begin with your business — model, tax exposure,
ownership and expansion plans — then recommend the jurisdiction and structure that fit. Our
integrated practice delivers it end-to-end: formation, corporate structuring, tax, audit, compliance
and operational support under one partnership.

We serve founders raising capital in London, family offices structuring across the GCC, and
multinationals expanding into Saudi Arabia — across our eleven jurisdictions. We remain independent,
partner-led and accountable to our clients, so every recommendation follows commercial logic, never
a sales target.

How We Work

## From First Call to Fully Operational.

A structured six-step engagement — transparent at every stage, partner-supervised throughout.

01

### Initial Consultation

A partner-led call to understand your business model, target markets, and ownership objectives — no
obligation, no junior intake.

02

### Structure & Jurisdiction

Our partners recommend the optimal jurisdiction and legal structure — mainland, free zone, or
offshore — based on your commercial and tax position.

03

### Document Preparation

Every required document prepared: memoranda of association, shareholder agreements, notarisations,
attestations, and certified translations.

04

### Regulatory Submission

Applications submitted directly to the relevant authority — DET, DMCC, ADGM, DIFC, or any of the 45+
free zones we operate across.

05

### Licensing & Approvals

We coordinate with regulators, respond to queries, and track every approval milestone until your
trade licence is issued.

06

### Bank Account & Compliance

Corporate banking opened, visas processed, and your engagement transitioned to ongoing tax, audit,
and compliance support.

New Products

### EXBA18V-80
* High-power tabless cell technology – provides lower inner resistance for reduced battery heating,
  increased power, longer runtime and optimized performance
* Outstanding power and runtime – deliver up to 140% more instantaneous maximum power* and up to
  120% longer runtime** than the core18v® 4 ah battery (gba18v40)
* Bosch-exclusive coolpack™ 2.0 technology – cools the battery and helps provide longer lifetime
  compared to non-coolpack™ bosch 18v batteries

[ Product details ][231]

New Products

### GKE18V-20N
* 8 in bar length – delivers a large cutting area to increase efficiency
* Brushless motor – delivers efficient power and a 23.6 ft/s chain speed for fast, consistent
  cutting with extended runtime
* High cuts per charge – for up to 350 cuts per charge with a 18V 4 Ah battery (sold separately)
  when cutting 2”x2” pressure-treated wood

[ Product details ][232]

New Products

### GSC18V-16EN
* Efficient brushless motor – provides an equivalent of 700w of corded power for fast, clean cuts
* Lightweight, ergonomic design – with slim, soft grip for enhanced comfort and reduced fatigue
* Robust design – with maintenance-free components for durable use

## FAQs:Corporate Zero Waste & Recycling Info

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### Why Zero Waste?

It’s good for you. As an industrial manufacturer, you know how many extra costs are associated with
baling and disposal. But with our recycling equipment setup on your premises, you’ll never have to
shell out to have leftover materials packaged up for disposal again.

It’s good for the planet. The more materials we can recover and reuse, the less we’ll be forced to
draw on natural resources and deplete our planet’s forests. This creates a better future for the
generations that will come after us. If your goal is to have zero waste, you need our services.

It’s good for your customers. If you’re paying to have your business’s boxes packed up and taken to
a landfill, you’re likely passing on some disposal costs to your clients. But with our cardboard
recycling services, it’s easy to keep your services affordable (and profitable!).

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What’s the Difference Between Reusing and Recycling?

Reusing is about extending the life of an item in its current form, while recycling involves
breaking down materials to create something new. Both practices are vital for reducing waste and
conserving resources, but reusing is generally more energy-efficient as it doesn't involve the
energy-intensive processes required for recycling. If you have boxes that are in good shape,
contribute to the [circular economy][38] and reuse them before you recycle them.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Is the Quality of Your Used Boxes?

Our boxes are extremely high-quality. In fact, they are often stronger and in better condition than
new boxes. Generally, if you purchase new boxes, they are rated 32 [ECT][39], 200 lb Bursting Test
rating, with a maximum load of 40 lbs per carton. The used boxes that we provide, however, are
significantly stronger. With a 44 ECT rating, 275 lb Bursting Test rating, and 65 lb maximum load
per carton, our reused boxes are usually stronger than new.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### How Much Do You Save Companies on Their Box Costs?

On average, companies save 30-40% by buying reused boxes instead of new. For major corporations that
may spend $10 million annually on new boxes, our services could save you up to $4 million! When you
add up that savings with the benefits of reaching your zero waste goals, the choice between new
boxes and reused is clear.
[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### Do Your Boxes Have Print on Them?

They sure do. That’s the nature of reused boxes. If you find yourself caught up on this, ask
yourself: Who is seeing these boxes? Unless your answer is your end consumer, the print on the boxes
doesn’t really matter. Take pride in your reused, printed boxes - they’re helping you save money and
the planet!
[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Can I Expect in a Consultation?

Your free consultation includes a review of your current program, as well as your facility’s overall
zero waste goals. Based on that information, we will determine the best way to optimize your
recycling process while generating the maximum amount of revenue. Ready for your consultation? [Call
to schedule today!][40]

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Locations Do You Serve?

We offer box pickup and box delivery services within a 250 mile radius of Atlanta, plus along all of
our routes. We run routes daily from [Atlanta to Birmingham, Nashville, Jacksonville, and
Greensboro][41]. If you’re not in the Atlanta area or along one of our routes, we offer LTL
transfers.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### How Do You Know When My Location Needs a Box Pickup?

With decades of experience, we draw on historical data for your company or industry so we know
exactly when your busiest times of year are. We’ll schedule our pickups accordingly. We also pride
ourselves on the relationships we build with plant managers. If you need a pickup ahead of your
scheduled time, just give us a call and we’ll send one of our trusted drivers right over.

## FAQs:Corporate Zero Waste & Recycling Info

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### Why Zero Waste?

It’s good for you. As an industrial manufacturer, you know how many extra costs are associated with
baling and disposal. But with our recycling equipment setup on your premises, you’ll never have to
shell out to have leftover materials packaged up for disposal again.

It’s good for the planet. The more materials we can recover and reuse, the less we’ll be forced to
draw on natural resources and deplete our planet’s forests. This creates a better future for the
generations that will come after us. If your goal is to have zero waste, you need our services.

It’s good for your customers. If you’re paying to have your business’s boxes packed up and taken to
a landfill, you’re likely passing on some disposal costs to your clients. But with our cardboard
recycling services, it’s easy to keep your services affordable (and profitable!).

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What’s the Difference Between Reusing and Recycling?

Reusing is about extending the life of an item in its current form, while recycling involves
breaking down materials to create something new. Both practices are vital for reducing waste and
conserving resources, but reusing is generally more energy-efficient as it doesn't involve the
energy-intensive processes required for recycling. If you have boxes that are in good shape,
contribute to the [circular economy][38] and reuse them before you recycle them.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Is the Quality of Your Used Boxes?

Our boxes are extremely high-quality. In fact, they are often stronger and in better condition than
new boxes. Generally, if you purchase new boxes, they are rated 32 [ECT][39], 200 lb Bursting Test
rating, with a maximum load of 40 lbs per carton. The used boxes that we provide, however, are
significantly stronger. With a 44 ECT rating, 275 lb Bursting Test rating, and 65 lb maximum load
per carton, our reused boxes are usually stronger than new.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### How Much Do You Save Companies on Their Box Costs?

On average, companies save 30-40% by buying reused boxes instead of new. For major corporations that
may spend $10 million annually on new boxes, our services could save you up to $4 million! When you
add up that savings with the benefits of reaching your zero waste goals, the choice between new
boxes and reused is clear.
[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### Do Your Boxes Have Print on Them?

They sure do. That’s the nature of reused boxes. If you find yourself caught up on this, ask
yourself: Who is seeing these boxes? Unless your answer is your end consumer, the print on the boxes
doesn’t really matter. Take pride in your reused, printed boxes - they’re helping you save money and
the planet!
[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Can I Expect in a Consultation?

Your free consultation includes a review of your current program, as well as your facility’s overall
zero waste goals. Based on that information, we will determine the best way to optimize your
recycling process while generating the maximum amount of revenue. Ready for your consultation? [Call
to schedule today!][40]

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### What Locations Do You Serve?

We offer box pickup and box delivery services within a 250 mile radius of Atlanta, plus along all of
our routes. We run routes daily from [Atlanta to Birmingham, Nashville, Jacksonville, and
Greensboro][41]. If you’re not in the Atlanta area or along one of our routes, we offer LTL
transfers.

[Artboard 102] [Artboard 103]

### How Do You Know When My Location Needs a Box Pickup?

With decades of experience, we draw on historical data for your company or industry so we know
exactly when your busiest times of year are. We’ll schedule our pickups accordingly. We also pride
ourselves on the relationships we build with plant managers. If you need a pickup ahead of your
scheduled time, just give us a call and we’ll send one of our trusted drivers right over.

# Welcome to BuddyBoardGames

Play board games with friends - get started in seconds - no sign-in required

##### Poker

No-Limit Texas Hold'em. Bluff, bet, and win the pot. 👥2-6

##### Blackjack

Beat the dealer without going over 21. 👥2-6

##### Euchre

Team up with a partner and outplay the other team in this fast-paced trick-taking game. 👥4

W N

##### Hangman

Take turns guessing letters to reveal the secret word before the figure is complete. 👥2-8

##### Tic Tac Toe

Get three of your marks in a row to win. 👥2

##### Memory

Flip cards, remember where they are, and collect the most matching pairs to win. 👥2-6

B7

##### Bingo

Mark your card as numbers are called and be the first to shout Bingo! 👥2-8

##### Dominoes

Build chains, block opponents, and turn the tiles in your favor. 👥2-4

##### Rummy

Form sets and runs, then be the first to empty your hand. 👥2-6

##### Gin Rummy

Build runs and sets, then knock before your opponent. 👥2

##### Go Fish

Ask for cards, make matching sets, and catch the biggest haul to win. 👥2-6

##### Hearts

Avoid hearts and the Queen of Spades to score the fewest points and win. 👥4

##### Cribbage

Rack up combos as you race your opponent to 121 points on a colorful board. 👥2-4

##### Battleship

Sink your opponent's ships before they sink yours in this game of naval wits. 👥2

##### Uno

Win rounds by being the first to get rid of your cards in this colorful card classic. 👥2-6

##### Yahtzee

Try to outscore your opponents in this addictive mix of Poker and dice. 👥1-8

##### Set

Be the quickest to collect sets of cards in this brain-twisting battle of wits. 👥1-6

##### Connect 4

Outrace your opponent to four in a row in any direction. 👥2

##### Chess

Strategize your way to checkmate in this age-old boardgame. 👥2

##### Checkers

Jump over your opponent's pieces to win. 👥2

##### Crazy 8s

First to get rid of their cards wins - and eights are wild. 👥2-6

##### Azul

Claim tiles to try to rack up bonuses and build the highest scoring wall. 👥1-4

##### Spades

First to 500 wins in this classic trick-taking card game - but don't bid wrong! 👥2-4

🔥

##### Farkle

Try to keep your hot hand going - but don't Farkle, or you'll lose everything. 👥1-12

##### Oh Heck

A twist on trick-taking games, where someone always gets stiffed. 👥2-6

##### Wizard

A trick-taking game where Wizards always win and Jesters always lose. 👥2-6

What's New?
* Find a buddy: match with other players looking for a game
* New games: Poker, Blackjack, Hearts, Euchre, Go Fish, Rummy, Gin Rummy, Dominoes, Bingo, Memory,
  Tic Tac Toe, Hangman
* Play with Buddy the Beaver is now available for everyone, in select games
* Mobile: improved touch controls and layouts for playing cards on phones and tablets
* We've introduced ads to help keep things going; supporters play ad free
* Supporter extras : remove player, spectate, and room themes
* Bug fixes: Battleship, Cribbage, Uno, room management
* Features: Cribbage 3-4 players, Uno custom rules, tied games support

**About BuddyBoardGames**

We built BuddyBoardGames so we could play our favorite board games remotely with friends and family
during the COVID-19 lockdown of 2020. Our goal is simple, easy fun. To get started, select any game
above and create a room to invite a buddy to play.

BuddyBoardGames does not require accounts. To support the site, we show light ads with sensitive
categories blocked. We only store the minimal data needed for games to function. You can read more
in our [privacy policy][59].

For feedback, questions, or issues contact us at [buddyboardgames@gmail.com][60].

You can also follow BuddyBoardGames on [Instagram][61] for updates on new games and features.

**Support BuddyBoardGames **

Enjoying BuddyBoardGames? You can buy us a coffee to help keep things running smoothly and support
future improvements.

As a thank you, supporters get access to a few extras:
* Ad-free play
* Remove Player
* Spectate games
* Change room themes

Supporter features are marked with a icon.

# Welcome to BuddyBoardGames

Play board games with friends - get started in seconds - no sign-in required

##### Poker

No-Limit Texas Hold'em. Bluff, bet, and win the pot. 👥2-6

##### Blackjack

Beat the dealer without going over 21. 👥2-6

##### Euchre

Team up with a partner and outplay the other team in this fast-paced trick-taking game. 👥4

W N

##### Hangman

Take turns guessing letters to reveal the secret word before the figure is complete. 👥2-8

##### Tic Tac Toe

Get three of your marks in a row to win. 👥2

##### Memory

Flip cards, remember where they are, and collect the most matching pairs to win. 👥2-6

B7

##### Bingo

Mark your card as numbers are called and be the first to shout Bingo! 👥2-8

##### Dominoes

Build chains, block opponents, and turn the tiles in your favor. 👥2-4

##### Rummy

Form sets and runs, then be the first to empty your hand. 👥2-6

##### Gin Rummy

Build runs and sets, then knock before your opponent. 👥2

##### Go Fish

Ask for cards, make matching sets, and catch the biggest haul to win. 👥2-6

##### Hearts

Avoid hearts and the Queen of Spades to score the fewest points and win. 👥4

##### Cribbage

Rack up combos as you race your opponent to 121 points on a colorful board. 👥2-4

##### Battleship

Sink your opponent's ships before they sink yours in this game of naval wits. 👥2

##### Uno

Win rounds by being the first to get rid of your cards in this colorful card classic. 👥2-6

##### Yahtzee

Try to outscore your opponents in this addictive mix of Poker and dice. 👥1-8

##### Set

Be the quickest to collect sets of cards in this brain-twisting battle of wits. 👥1-6

##### Connect 4

Outrace your opponent to four in a row in any direction. 👥2

##### Chess

Strategize your way to checkmate in this age-old boardgame. 👥2

##### Checkers

Jump over your opponent's pieces to win. 👥2

##### Crazy 8s

First to get rid of their cards wins - and eights are wild. 👥2-6

##### Azul

Claim tiles to try to rack up bonuses and build the highest scoring wall. 👥1-4

##### Spades

First to 500 wins in this classic trick-taking card game - but don't bid wrong! 👥2-4

🔥

##### Farkle

Try to keep your hot hand going - but don't Farkle, or you'll lose everything. 👥1-12

##### Oh Heck

A twist on trick-taking games, where someone always gets stiffed. 👥2-6

##### Wizard

A trick-taking game where Wizards always win and Jesters always lose. 👥2-6

* Play with Buddy the Beaver is now available for everyone, in select games
* Mobile: improved touch controls and layouts for playing cards on phones and tablets
* We've introduced ads to help keep things going; supporters play ad free
* Supporter extras : remove player, spectate, and room themes
* Bug fixes: Battleship, Cribbage, Uno, room management
* Features: Cribbage 3-4 players, Uno custom rules, tied games support

**About BuddyBoardGames**

We built BuddyBoardGames so we could play our favorite board games remotely with friends and family
during the COVID-19 lockdown of 2020. Our goal is simple, easy fun. To get started, select any game
above and create a room to invite a buddy to play.

BuddyBoardGames does not require accounts. To support the site, we show light ads with sensitive
categories blocked. We only store the minimal data needed for games to function. You can read more

streaming options. ## Cox Service Offerings ### Multi GIG Internet + Cox Mobile #### Do more with
Multi GIG internet Score a 5-year Price Lock Guarantee when you add Cox Mobile to your Multi GIG
internet plan. Plus, unlimited data and wall-to-wall Panoramic Wifi included. 2 Gbps download
speeds. [Lock it in](https://www.cox.com/residential/special-offers/bundles.html) 2 Gbps for 5-year
lock. Mobile speeds reduced after 20 Gigs usage per month. With at least 1 unlimited Cox Mobile line
plus internet speeds of 2 Gbps. Taxes and fees excluded. ### Cox Mobile & Internet Bundle mobile &
internet to save, starting at **$70/mo**. [Shop mobile
plans](https://www.cox.com/residential/mobile/cell-phone-plans.html) ### Cox TV & Streaming
Everything worth watching, one place, starting at **$20/mo**. [Shop TV &
streaming](https://www.cox.com/residential/tv.html) ### Cox Home Phone Crystal-clear, reliable home
phone service, starting at **$20/mo**. [Shop home phone](https://www.cox.com/residential/phone.html)
## About Our Company ### Powering connections that matter Learn more about how we keep people
connected, both online and out in the world. - **Trusted for over 60 years** — Over 7 million homes
and businesses count on us — including mobile plans that run on the network with unbeatable 5G
reliability. [Meet Cox](https://www.cox.com/aboutus/home.html) - **Here for those who need us most**
— We already deliver affordable internet options to over 1 million qualifying households. Find out
more about how our people are giving back. [About
engagement](https://www.cox.com/aboutus/community.html) - **We are bettering our world** — We've
invested over $100 million in sustainability projects. See what else we're working on. [Our
sustainability](https://www.coxenterprises.com/our-impact/sustainability-cox-conserves) ##
Frequently Asked Questions ### What types of services does Cox offer? Cox provides four key services
to over 7,000,000 homes in the U.S.: high-speed internet plans, mobile plans, TV & streaming plans,
and home phone plans. ### Are Cox Internet and services available in my area? Enter your address in
the search tool above to find out if plans are available in your area. ### How much does Cox
Internet cost? Cox Internet plans start at $30/mo for qualifying customers, offering a variety of
internet speeds all the way up to 2 GIG. ### Does Cox have unlimited internet? Yes, unlimited
internet data is available with select plans and add-ons. To get unlimited data included in your
plan, bundle an internet plan of 500 Mbps or higher with an unlimited mobile line from Cox Mobile.
You can also purchase an unlimited data plan separately for any internet plan. ### What's included
in a typical Cox Internet bundle? Cox bundles are completely customizable, so you can include the
exact services you want. And when you bundle internet and mobile, you could qualify for extra
monthly savings, unlimited internet data add-ons and a Price Lock Guarantee. --- ## Legal
Disclosures **Cox Mobile** 5G capable devices required to access the 5G network. Coverage not
available in all areas. Cox Mobile runs on the network with unbeatable 5G reliability as measured by
Ookla, LLC in the U.S., 1H 2024. Results may vary. Not an endorsement. Wifi not tested. Cox Internet
is powered by fiber and connected to the premises via coaxial cable."

What is DishTV?
DishTV is India's leading Direct-to-Home (DTH) service provider. With DishTV, you get crystal-clear
picture, high-definition audio, and access to hundreds of TV channels — from entertainment and
sports to news and kids’ programs — directly on your TV.
Why choose DishTV?
* Affordable Packages: Customize your own pack and pay only for the channels you watch.
* Easy Installation: Get Dish TV set-up quickly at your home with a simple phone call or online
  booking.
* Recharge Anytime: Top-up or pay your bills online, through our app or website.
* Hassle-free Customer Support: Our team is available 24/7 to help you resolve any issues promptly.
  · Add-Ons and Services: Enjoy additional services like DishTV Smart+, [multi-TV connection,][86]
  and video-on-demand.
How DishTV works?
DishTV uses a small satellite dish installed at your home to receive signals directly from the
satellite in space. The signals are routed through your set-top box and displayed on your TV in real
time.
Who should set DishTV?

# The leading English test for free online certification

Take the EF SET and get an accurate assessment of your English level from home. Companies can use
the EF SET to measure English skills in the workplace at scale.

Test your English now
[topBadge][rightBadge][leftBadge][bottomBadge][mobileTopBadge][mobileRightBadgeOne][mobileRightBadge
Two][mobileLeftBadge][mobileBottomBadge]

## **Why **

## **EF SET?**

[infoIcon]

#### It's Reliable.

**Created by experts. **This online English proficiency test has been developed over a decade with
leading scientists in the field of English assessment. [Our research.][78]

[infoIcon]

#### It's Accessible.

**An English level test for everyone. **EF SET is available on any desktop, tablet, or mobile
device. All you need is an internet connection and a quiet place where you can concentrate.

[infoIcon]

#### It's Free.

**Why pay for accurate results? **There shouldn't be any barriers to testing your English. English
tests are an essential tool for students and professionals.

### A scalable English testing solution for any organization

We have helped over 10,000 schools, companies, universities, and governments around the world define
proficiency benchmarks using our English level test.

[English assessment solutions ][88]

Receive a free personalized online English certificate when you take one of our exams. You can
easily add it to your CV or LinkedIn profile.

The EF SET builds on EF's legacy of producing life-changing experiences by harnessing new

through a reliable, accessible English test. [Read about EF][90]

# Custom Boxes Tailored for Every Product, Designed for Every Need

No product is the same, and neither should its packaging be. From sturdy protective solutions to
luxury presentations, our custom boxes are designed to fit every shape, style, and industry need.
Whether it’s minimalist kraft for sustainability, rigid boxes for premium appeal, or innovative
die-cut designs for branding impact, we craft packaging that goes beyond containment—it enhances,
protects, and elevates your product’s presence.

## Material Excellence – Strength, Sustainability & Versatility for Every Product

The foundation of great packaging starts with the right material. Whether it’s eco-friendly kraft
for a natural appeal, sturdy cardboard for everyday reliability, or premium rigid stock for an
elevated brand presence, we provide materials that ensure strength, sustainability, and stunning
presentation. Each selection is carefully tailored to match product protection needs, industry
standards, and customer expectations, making sure your packaging feels as good as it looks.

## Precision Shapes – Designed to Fit, Styled to Impress

Every product demands a box shape that complements its form and function. From classic square and
rectangular designs for secure stacking to eye-catching pillow, tulip, gable, pyramid, and diamond
shapes that elevate presentation, our custom boxes are crafted to enhance visibility, improve
handling, and create a memorable unboxing experience. Whether sleek and professional or bold and
innovative, each shape is designed to seamlessly align with your brand’s vision and product needs.

## Structural Design Mastery – Functionality Meets Aesthetic Excellence

Custom boxes are more than just containers—they are engineered for usability, durability, and brand
impact. From secure tuck-end closures for effortless assembly to sleeve and two-piece boxes that add
a touch of elegance, every style is designed to enhance product accessibility, reinforce protection,
and create a seamless unboxing experience. Whether for retail display, secure shipping, or premium
presentation, our structural innovations ensure that every box not only holds a product but elevates
its perceived value.

## Luxury & Durability Combined – Rigid Boxes for a Premium Experience

True luxury packaging is more than just aesthetics—it’s about strength, sophistication, and a
seamless unboxing experience. Our rigid boxes are crafted from high-quality materials to provide
unmatched durability and premium appeal, making them ideal for high-end retail, gifts, and luxury
branding. Whether it’s the magnetic closure boxes that exude elegance, the flip-top and book-style
designs that offer a sleek reveal, or the collapsible styles that combine storage efficiency with
refined presentation, each box is tailored to elevate your product’s value and create lasting
impressions. With options like drawer-style and sleeve-and-tray configurations, we ensure that every
product is not just housed but presented with perfection.

## Vivid Branding & Eco-Friendly Printing – Bringing Your Packaging to Life

Every box is an extension of your brand, and high-quality printing ensures that your message stands
out. We offer precision printing techniques that bring designs to life with rich colors, crisp
details, and sustainable solutions.

From CMYK for vibrant full-color visuals to PMS for precise brand-matched tones, our printing
capabilities allow for stunning graphics inside and out, ensuring a seamless brand experience from
the moment the package is opened. Using water-based, soy, and vegetable inks, we provide
eco-conscious printing solutions that maintain bold, high-definition results while minimizing
environmental impact.

A well-crafted box isn’t just about structure—it’s about the perfect finishing touch that enhances

tailored cushioning and structured placement, reducing movement and preventing damage. Meanwhile,

before they even open the box.

Добрый день! Я частный репетитор по английскому языку в Санкт-Петербурге с более чем 20-летним
опытом работы, из них я два года преподавала в элитной гимназии, после чего перешла на частное
репетиторство. Я преподаю детям, подросткам и взрослым, выезжаю на корпоративное обучение, учу
разговорному английскому, деловому английскому, английскому для путешествий.

и отработку конструкций в разговорной практике, с детьми — на игровую форму и школьную программу.
Для путешествий — интенсивный курс с реальными диалогами, для бизнеса — деловая лексика, переговоры

### 5 причин изучать английский язык со мной:

**
1. Большой опыт работы с учениками в возрасте от трёх до пятидесяти лет
2. [Гибкие цены][50]
3. Опыт работы не только в сфере преподавания, но также [литературного перевода][51] и туризма
4. Профильное второе образование.
5. Я не только репетитор по английскому языку, но и литератор, член Союза Писателей
   Санкт-Петербурга. Творческий подход ко всему - основа моей деятельности.
6. Я сама создала этот сайт, написав программное обеспечение к [интерактивному словарю][52] и
   [интерактивному учебнику с упражнениями][53].

## ABOUT US

**Formuler.com** is the ultimate destination for purchasing Formuler set-top boxes and accessories,
delivering to customers all over Canada and the USA.

#### Who we are ?

In Canada and the USA, we are the exclusive distributor of Formuler and Dreamlink products and
accessories. Our primary focus is to provide our customers with the best and authentic quality
products. We have established a vast network of resellers throughout Canada and the USA, ensuring
easy access to our technology enthusiasts. As the sole distributor in these regions, our aim is to
meet the needs of bulk buyers, resellers, and end users. **Formuler.com** is operated by Directlinx
Electronix Limited, located in Scarborough, Toronto, Canada. Since its inception in 2001, Directlinx
Electronix has held a prominent position in the electronic supplies industry and has successfully
partnered with renowned brands to cater to the electronic supply needs across every corner of Canada
and the USA.

#### What we do?

At **Formuler.com**, we offer a diverse range of set-top boxes, designed to cater to a wide array of
customer needs. With varying features and technologies, we ensure that our customers have the
opportunity to select and purchase according to their specific usage requirements and budget. As a
reliable shopping site, we prioritize supreme quality, exceptional service, and unbeatable prices,
which have been the cornerstone of our success and progress. Our customers experience the highest
levels of quality, authenticity, and trust on a daily basis.

Whether you are purchasing for your home, business, or resale purposes, you can always rely on us to
provide authentic, reliable, and cutting-edge technology products, along with the best deals and
services available.

Resellers/ Bulk Buyers

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does Foxit PDF Editor compare to Adobe Acrobat?

[Foxit PDF Editor][53] is often chosen as a cost-effective, easy-to-use alternative to Adobe
Acrobat. Users love its clean, intuitive layout and features that cover all the basics—and then
some—without the Adobe price tag. Many users find Foxit’s customer support more responsive, too,
which is always a plus!

### What platforms are Foxit products available on?

Foxit’s PDF software tools are available on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, so you can work from
just about any device. We even offer a browser-based version, so all you ever need is an internet
connection to access your PDFs.

### Is Foxit secure for handling sensitive documents?

Absolutely! Foxit is committed to keeping your documents safe. We use top-notch security measures
like passwords, encryption, and secure deletion to protect your information. You can rest easy
knowing your sensitive files are in good hands.

### Can I collaborate with others using Foxit PDF solutions?

Definitely! Foxit’s PDF software makes it super easy to work with your team. You can review,
comment, and annotate documents in real time and even get quick digital signatures with Foxit eSign.
No more juggling multiple versions or waiting around for approvals.

### What kind of licensing options does Foxit offer for organizations?

Foxit offers flexible licensing options to fit your organization's specific needs. Whether you're a
small team or a large enterprise, Foxit has you covered. You can choose between subscription-based
plans or one-time purchases. Plus, we offer volume discounts for larger teams, making it easy to
find a cost-effective solution. Explore [volume licensing options][54].

### Can Foxit integrate with other tools or software?

Yes! Foxit plays well with others, integrating smoothly with popular tools like Microsoft Office
365, Google Drive, and Salesforce. This means you can easily work with your PDFs right within your
favorite apps, saving you time and hassle.

### Does Foxit offer cloud-based PDF solutions?

Yes, Foxit has cloud-based PDF software solutions, like Foxit PDF Editor and Foxit eSign. You can
create, store, edit, and share PDFs in the cloud, plus collaborate in real time—all without needing
to download extra software.

### Does Foxit support batch processing of documents?

It does! With Foxit PDF Editor, you can batch-process tasks like converting, merging, or compressing
multiple PDFs at once. This feature is particularly useful for businesses with lots of documents,
helping to complete tasks efficiently and save time.

### Does Foxit support OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology?

Yes, Foxit’s OCR feature lets you turn scanned images and PDFs into searchable, editable documents.
It’s great for keeping digital records of paper documents, so you can find what you need with just a
quick search.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does Foxit PDF Editor compare to Adobe Acrobat?

[Foxit PDF Editor][53] is often chosen as a cost-effective, easy-to-use alternative to Adobe
Acrobat. Users love its clean, intuitive layout and features that cover all the basics—and then
some—without the Adobe price tag. Many users find Foxit’s customer support more responsive, too,
which is always a plus!

### What platforms are Foxit products available on?

Foxit’s PDF software tools are available on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, so you can work from
just about any device. We even offer a browser-based version, so all you ever need is an internet
connection to access your PDFs.

### Is Foxit secure for handling sensitive documents?

Absolutely! Foxit is committed to keeping your documents safe. We use top-notch security measures
like passwords, encryption, and secure deletion to protect your information. You can rest easy
knowing your sensitive files are in good hands.

### Can I collaborate with others using Foxit PDF solutions?

Definitely! Foxit’s PDF software makes it super easy to work with your team. You can review,
comment, and annotate documents in real time and even get quick digital signatures with Foxit eSign.
No more juggling multiple versions or waiting around for approvals.

### What kind of licensing options does Foxit offer for organizations?

Foxit offers flexible licensing options to fit your organization's specific needs. Whether you're a
small team or a large enterprise, Foxit has you covered. You can choose between subscription-based
plans or one-time purchases. Plus, we offer volume discounts for larger teams, making it easy to
find a cost-effective solution. Explore [volume licensing options][54].

### Can Foxit integrate with other tools or software?

Yes! Foxit plays well with others, integrating smoothly with popular tools like Microsoft Office
365, Google Drive, and Salesforce. This means you can easily work with your PDFs right within your
favorite apps, saving you time and hassle.

### Does Foxit offer cloud-based PDF solutions?

Yes, Foxit has cloud-based PDF software solutions, like Foxit PDF Editor and Foxit eSign. You can
create, store, edit, and share PDFs in the cloud, plus collaborate in real time—all without needing
to download extra software.

### Does Foxit support batch processing of documents?

It does! With Foxit PDF Editor, you can batch-process tasks like converting, merging, or compressing
multiple PDFs at once. This feature is particularly useful for businesses with lots of documents,
helping to complete tasks efficiently and save time.

### Does Foxit support OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology?

Yes, Foxit’s OCR feature lets you turn scanned images and PDFs into searchable, editable documents.
It’s great for keeping digital records of paper documents, so you can find what you need with just a
quick search.

# Grammar Monster

[our story...][11]

## Free English Grammar Lessons and Tests

[sitemap][12] ▸home page
Welcome to Grammar Monster!

We have hundreds of lessons, tests, games, and word lists covering everything from basic vocabulary
to tips for advanced writers. The site is packed with teaching resources, including video lessons,
printable word lists, and shareable tests.

There is no log-in, and **everything is free!** There are a couple of ads, and that's how I fund the
site. (There are no ads in the lesson content. None. Not one.)

## What Do You Want?

Are you training for your black belt in grammar? Are you teaching new learners? Here are 10 sample
lessons at different levels of requirement. Remember that these are just samples. We have [thousands
of free lessons, tests, and videos][13].

I'm a tutor of absolute beginners.

[1. Useful vocabulary by category (lessons & games)][14] [2. "telling the time" (interactive
lesson)][15] [3. "counting in English" (lesson & game)][16] [4. "introducing yourself" (role-play
lesson)][17] [5. "talking about your family" (role-play lesson)][18] [6. "colours" (games &
flashcards)][19] [7. "frequency adverbs" (games & flashcards)][20] [8. "ordinals & fractions" (games
& flashcards)][21] [9. "shapes" (video)][22] [10. "English for beginners" (list of resources)][23]

I'm a tutor.
I need word games and grammar tests.

[1. Match the pairs (for the "parts of speech")][24] [2. "Look-cover-write-check" (for
spelling)][25] [3. "Word Builder" (for vocabulary)][26] [4. "Word Up" (for advanced vocabulary)][27]
[5. "HangMan" (for vocabulary)][28] [6. 1,000 useful words (drag-and-drop game)][29] [7. "Fish" game
(for identifying adverbs)][30] [8. "Bubble pop" game (for identifying prepositions)][31] [9.
Match-the-pairs game (for identifying pronouns)][32] [10. Insert-the-punctuation test (for all
punctuation)][33]

I'm a native speaker.
I am new to grammatical terms.

[1. "The Parts of speech" (video)][34] [2. "Warm up" lesson on adjectives][35] [3. Full lesson on
nouns][36] [4. Subjects][37] [5. "Warm up" lesson on verbs][38] [6. Introduction to verb
conjugation][39] [7. Introduction to grammatical "number"][40] [8. Full lesson on phrases][41] [9.
Introduction to sentence types][42] [10. Full lesson on the "parts of speech"][43]

I'm a native speaker.
I want to take my grammar to an advanced level.

[1. Misplaced modifiers][44] [2. Restrictive modifiers][45] [3. Parenthetical punctuation][46] [4.
Compound predicates][47] [5. Complements][48] [6. Zeugma][49] [7. Conjunctive adverbs][50] [8.
Singular "they" (video)][51] [9. Ending sentences with prepositions (the nuances)][52] [10.
Apostrophes for joint ownership][53]

I'm a student.
I want to improve my writing skills.

[1. The run-on sentence (a killer lesson!)][54] [2. Verbs of attribution (for referencing)][55] [3.
Using "however" properly][56] [4. Most common punctuation errors][57] [5. Hyphens in compound
adjectives][58] [6. Commas before "which," "that," and "who"][59] [7. Apostrophes in time
expressions][60] [8. Square brackets in quotations][61] [9. Commas with fronted adverbials][62] [10.
Commas before conjunctions (and, but, or, etc.)][63]

I'm a business person.
I want to sharpen my writing.

[1. Writing parallel lists (important lesson!)][64] [2. Selecting the right words (i.e.,
diction)][65] [3. Avoiding the run-on sentence (a common error)][66] [4. Using "however"
properly][67] [5. Using hyphens in compound adjectives][68] [6. Understanding subject-verb
agreement][69] [7. Using commas before "which," "that," and "who"][70] [8. Using commas before
conjunctions (e.g., "and")][71] [9. Saving words with participle phrases][72] [10. Explaining
through analogies][73]

I'm a creative writer.
I want to generate some flair.

[1. Anastrophe (playing with word order)][74] [2. Metonyms (using associated words)][75] [3. Emotive
language (being judge and jury)][76] [4. Assonance (adding flair with vowels)][77] [5. Consonance
(adding flair with consonants)][78] [6. Anaphora (repeating deliberately)][79] [7. Zeugma (playing
with sentence structure)][80] [8. Ethos (writing to influence)][81] [9. Point of view (writing to
engage)][82] [10. Analogies (painting pictures with words)][83]

I want to create my own curriculum.

[choose your own lessons, tests, or videos from the sitemap][84]

Grammar Monster is a one-man show (if we don't count my Jack Russell). If you like the content and
style, please promote it. If you're a training company, a school, or a home-school community, then
please provide a link on your site to any useful Grammar Monster lessons. It really, really helps
keep "the local patisseries afloat in the wake of the Walmarts."

If you do, please let me know. If Grammar Monster doesn't have the lesson you need, let me know too
– I'l

## Four Core Structures, Engineered to Your Spec

Every brand shows up differently. We build the structure that fits yours, then refine the material,
finish, and detail until it's right.

[White rigid box with the hinged lid open, showing a slotted upper display tray and a pull-out
drawer in the base]

### Rigid Boxes

The structure behind luxury unboxing. Rigid, precise, built to protect and impress.

Explore
[White folding carton with a tuck-end closure and an arched die-cut window on the top panel]

### Folding Carton

Retail-ready cartons that hold shape, print sharp, and scale cleanly.

Explore
[Mailing boxes]

### Corrugated Boxes

Protective packaging engineered to survive the journey and still look the part.

Explore
[White paper bag with black woven webbing handles, shown with the gusset and base folds visible]

### Paper Bags

Branded carriers that extend the experience past the counter.

Explore

## Why brands choose GUKA

### In-house Engineering

Structure, tooling, and dielines handled under one roof, so your design holds up in production, not
just on screen.

### Finishes That Hold Up To Scrutiny

Foil, embossing, soft-touch, spot UV. The details your customers notice in the hand, executed
consistently across every unit.

### Quality At Scale

Inspection at every stage. The 50,000th box matches the sample you signed off on.

### One Partner, End To End Design Support Through Global Delivery, Managed By One Team

No brokers, no guesswork.

## From First Sample to Shelf-ready, Managed End to End

1

### Brief & Design support

We translate your concept and brand guidelines into a buildable spec.
2

### Sampling & Prototyping

You hold the real thing before committing to a run. Precision, not a throwaway proof.
3

### Sampling & Prototyping

Production Engineered tooling and controlled processes keep every unit on-spec.
4

### Quality Control

Multi-stage inspection before anything leaves the floor.
5

### Global Delivery

Coordinated logistics to your market, on schedule.

## Packaging That Understands Your Category

A fragrance box and a spirits box answer to different rules. We have built for both, and the
categories in between.

# MAG — designed for your IPTV/OTT business

MAGs are European set-top boxes for modern operators. Infomir manufactures them using Android TV™
and Linux. Since 2001, more than 4 500 MAG-operating IPTV/OTT projects have been launched across 150

## About KCNA Watch

KCNA Watch is an aggregator of official DPRK media output, which updates in real time.

Due to regular server outages and multiple occasions malicious scripts have been found on official
DPRK media sites, KCNA Watch mirrors all DPRK media for easy access and browsing.

Full copies of articles and PDFs are also hosted here due to the DPRK government’s regular deletion
and editing of archived materials.

Furthermore, unlike many official DPRK media sites, KCNA Watch allows for articles to be shared in
realtime via social media, with permalinks that can be cited in academic journals.

## About KCNA Watch

KCNA Watch is an aggregator of official DPRK media output, which updates in real time.

Due to regular server outages and multiple occasions malicious scripts have been found on official
DPRK media sites, KCNA Watch mirrors all DPRK media for easy access and browsing.

Full copies of articles and PDFs are also hosted here due to the DPRK government’s regular deletion
and editing of archived materials.

Furthermore, unlike many official DPRK media sites, KCNA Watch allows for articles to be shared in
realtime via social media, with permalinks that can be cited in academic journals.

# Common Questions About NAPCO Custom Packaging

##### What is your minimum order quantity?

NAPCO offers flexible minimums starting at just 1 unit for digital manufacturing and 5,000+ units
for traditional production. Unlike many packaging manufacturers, we removed the ceiling – not just
the floor.

##### How long does custom packaging take to produce?

Timeline depends on quantity and complexity:
• Prototyping and short run digital production (up to 5,000 units): 7 business days-3 weeks
• Traditional production (5,000+ units): 4-6 weeks

Request a quote for your specific project timeline.

**These timelines are based on current capacity, and we will update as that capacity changes
throughout the year.*

##### Do you offer packaging prototypes and samples?

Yes. NAPCO provides custom packaging prototypes and samples to validate design, structure, and
quality before full production. We offer both unprinted structural samples and digitally printed
samples with actual graphics.

##### What's the difference between digital and traditional packaging printing?

**Digital printing: **Best for 250-5,000 units, faster setup, no physical plates needed – perfect
for testing and short runs
**Traditional printing: **Best for 5,000+ units, more cost-efficient at scale – ideal for proven
products

NAPCO offers both, so you start with digital and seamlessly scale to traditional with the same
partner.

##### What industries do you serve?

NAPCO serves brands across industries including trading card games, vinyl records, wine & spirits,
healthcare, subscription boxes, cosmetics & beauty, and more.

##### Are you a US-based packaging manufacturer?

Yes. NAPCO is a family-owned packaging manufacturer based in Sparta, North Carolina. We’ve been
manufacturing custom packaging in the USA since 1977, offering responsive service, domestic
production, and reliable partnerships. 

##### Can NAPCO handle large-scale production runs?

Yes. NAPCO offers both digital manufacturing (up to 5,000 units) and traditional production for
larger runs — with no upper limit on volume. Brands can start with a 50-unit prototype and scale to
hundreds of thousands of units without ever switching vendors. That dual capability under one roof
is something less than 1% of the packaging industry can offer.

## OTT Business Mission

> OTT Business mission is to identify and explain new media technologies and services to help
> produce, distribute, and monetize streaming TV businesses.

## News

OTT Business covers new innovations, key business changes, and other information that impacts the
OTT and Streaming TV industry. This includes new types of products & services, market research and
changing trends, and changes in regulations. We publish top news stories in our monthly OTT Business
Magazine, on our Blog, Twitter, Discussion Groups, and our other media channels.

[Learn More][80]

## Magazine

OTT Business Magazines is a monthly publication (print & electronic) that covers key industry news,
articles on streaming TV options & implementations, TV research & market trends, buyers guide
directory of companies, products, and tools, conference & trade show event lists, and other
information to help produce, distribute, and monetize Internet TV & video services & applications.

[Learn More][81]
[OTT and Streaming TV Resource Document Sharing]

## Resources

OTT Business produces, gathers, and shares guides, sample plans, templates, and other resources that
help to setup, run, and monetize OTT and Streaming TV systems & services. This includes market
research, OTT Directory, white papers, OTT Dictionary, books, and courses.

[Learn More][82]

## Podcast

OTT Business Podcast sessions are a mix of interviews with industry experts and topic and lesson
guides on OTT and Streaming TV systems & services. It seems each day there is a new TV technology,
service, acronym, or other information that is dramatically changing your business or job. In
addition to learning cool stuff like interactive holograms that you can feel – yes, this is for real
– you will also discover new things you can do to improve your company, product, or job.

[Learn More][83]

# SET

A game where cards have symbols with different colors, shapes, number and filling.
A Set is three cards where every feature is either all the same, or all different.
Grab as many as you can: the player with the most Sets at the end wins!

## Versus mode

Challenge a friend to a wild game and find out who's best!

## AI mode

Play against your computer in easy, medium or hard mode!

Play

## Zen mode

No opponent, no score, no rush. Breath and have fun.

Tutorial
About
Color palette
Sound on

# SET

## About this game

**[Set][2] is a card game designed by Marsha Falco in 1974, and published by Set Enterprises in
1991.** This website aims at re-creating the game experience online. It is not in any way affiliated
with [Set Enterprises, Inc.][3] or the SET® card game. You can show your support to the game editors
by [buying a physical version of the game ($12.99)][4].

This website was designed by [Hugo Sainte-Marie][5] and is open source on [GitHub][6].

The typeface used on this website is [Inter][7] by [Rasmus Andersson][8].

# Pullman Residences Yerevan: A World-Class Premium Residential Complex

Pullman Residences Yerevan is a new residential complex redefining modern premium living in a prime
location in Yerevan. It offers two unique experiences: Pullman Living, with fully furnished,
extended-stay [residences ][11]that combine home comforts with hotel services.

Pullman Residences provides premium comfort with [high-end amenities][12], such as, wellness
facilities like sports areas and a spa, as well as access to restaurants and club lounges.

Our complex blend urban dynamism with a peaceful, comfortable lifestyle. It offers eco-friendly
spaces, walking areas, sports infrastructure, parking, coworking spaces, and a kids' club.

[WhatsApp Image 2024-11-01 at 23.37.26.jpeg]

## Heritage of Pullman Residences: A Story of Prestige 

Since 1867

Since its founding in 1867, the Pullman brand has presented new standards of premium living. With
its innovative and sophisticated approach, Pullman continues to expand and shape new lifestyles for
its residents worldwide. This premium brand embodies a sophisticated lifestyle designed for ultimate
convenience.

[Discover More][13]
[
][14]
[Door.jpg]

### Services & Benefits

Pullman Residences Yerevan provides a premium living experience with a number of services and
benefits. Our exclusive services and personalized benefits are designed to enhance your daily life,
giving you more time to focus on what truly matters. From concierge assistance and housekeeping to
priority access to Accor hospitality perks, every detail is tailored to provide ultimate comfort and
convenience.

[Discover More][15]
[
][16]
[RoomService.png]

### Exceptional Amenities

At Pullman, we believe in an effortless and enjoyable lifestyle. Our amenities are thoughtfully
curated to enhance your experience. Everything is designed with your comfort in mind, from wellness
facilities that help you recharge to dining options that satisfy every craving.

Enjoy outstanding service, modern conveniences, and inspiring spaces at Pullman Residences.

[Discover More][17]
[
][18]
[R7.jpg]

## A Resort You Can Call Home 

Pullman Residences Yerevan is located just 3-7 minutes from the city center and boasts a perfect
position at a height of 150 meters from city center. This provides residents unparalleled views of
the city and the opportunity to breathe fresh air while enjoying Ararat views.


The entire residency is maintained and serviced by Pullman staff, adhering to Accor Standards.
Homeowners enjoy impeccable service and high-quality maintenance, ensuring a comfortable  living
experience.

[Select Your Home][19]
[
][20]

## We See Wellness Differently

Our 20,000 sq. m site includes only 20% for development, emphasizing extensive common areas and
meticulously designed facilities

INDOOR COMMON AREAS

## [Project Partners][22]

## Corporate Profile

Accor is a world-leading augmented hospitality group offering unique and meaningful experiences in
5700 hotels, resorts, and residences across 110 countries for over 50 years. Beyond accommodations,
Accor enables new ways to live, work, and play with food & beverage, nightlife, well-being, and
coworking brands. Acoor’s portfolio of business accelerators amplifies hospitality distribution,
operations, and experience to drive business performance. Guests can access one of the world’s most
attractive hotel loyalty programs - Accor Live Limitless. Accor SA is publicly listed on the
Euronext Paris Stock Exchange (ISIN code: FR0000120404) and on the OTC Market (Ticker: ACRFY) in the
United States.

Pullman Hotels & Resorts delivers an experience that is upscale, upbeat, and ideally in tempo with
the global zeitgeist. Retaining the values of exploration, comfort, and dependability that drove it
to become a pioneering travel brand over 150 years ago, Pullman today features 155 worldwide
properties and +61 in Pipeline in 42 countries, including Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel, Pullman Park
Lane Hong Kong, Pullman Shanghai South, Pullman London St Pancras, and Pullman Sao Paulo Vila
Olimpia.

Since 2019, Technotun LLC has been shaping a brand-new culture in real estate. Our portfolio
includes completing a multifunctional residential building near Cascade, a testament to our
dedication to innovation.

Technotun is contributing to Armenia’s economy and offering exceptional investment opportunities,
setting new benchmarks in urban development.

BECAUSE THE PULLMAN LIFE IS ALWAYS REWARDING

## Frequently Asked Questions
* Exam‑Related
* Test Day & Conduct
* Post‑Exam & Admission
* Registration & Payment

What is the format of the SET exam?

The SET exam consists of 60 objective‑type questions, with no negative marking, covering General
English, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, and Analytical & Logical Reasoning.

How many attempts can I make?

You can attempt SET on two dates. The higher score will be considered for the final admission
process.

What should I bring to the test centre?

You must carry a printed copy of your admit card, a valid photo ID, and a passport‑size photograph.

Are electronic devices allowed?

No, electronic devices like calculators, mobile phones, and smartwatches are not permitted in the
test centre.

How are the results announced?

Results will be declared on May 20, 2026. Shortlisted candidates will then proceed to the next phase
of the admission process.

How is the SET score used?

The SET score is used for shortlisting candidates for the GD-PI-WAT rounds, which are a part of the
final admission process for each program.

How do I register for SET?

Register online by filling out the application form and paying the registration fee via the SET
website.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* Exam‑Related
* Test Day & Conduct
* Post‑Exam & Admission
* Registration & Payment

What is the format of the SET exam?

The SET exam consists of 60 objective‑type questions, with no negative marking, covering General
English, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, and Analytical & Logical Reasoning.

How many attempts can I make?

You can attempt SET on two dates. The higher score will be considered for the final admission
process.

What should I bring to the test centre?

You must carry a printed copy of your admit card, a valid photo ID, and a passport‑size photograph.

Are electronic devices allowed?

No, electronic devices like calculators, mobile phones, and smartwatches are not permitted in the
test centre.

How are the results announced?

Results will be declared on May 20, 2026. Shortlisted candidates will then proceed to the next phase
of the admission process.

How is the SET score used?

The SET score is used for shortlisting candidates for the GD-PI-WAT rounds, which are a part of the
final admission process for each program.

How do I register for SET?

Register online by filling out the application form and paying the registration fee via the SET
website.

## What Is TheTVApp?

Everything you need to know about The TV App

**TheTVApp** is a free online live TV streaming platform that delivers 100+ channels directly
through your web browser. Whether you call it **TheTVApp**, **The TV App**, **TVApp**, or **The
TVApp** - this is the official home of the service at [**TheTVApp.stream**][20].

Unlike cable or satellite TV that requires contracts, boxes, and monthly payments, TheTVApp gives
you instant, unrestricted access to live television. The TV App is designed for speed - no accounts,
no software, no setup. Just open TheTVApp.stream, pick a channel, and press play.

TheTVApp covers every major category: live sports, breaking news, blockbuster movies, entertainment
networks, kids shows, music channels, and documentaries. Streams run in HD where available, and new
channels are added to The TV App regularly so the lineup keeps growing.

The TV App works on every device with a browser - smartphones, tablets, laptops, desktops, and Smart
TVs. If it can open a webpage, it can run TheTVApp.

[TheTVApp - Watch free live TV channels online - The TV App official site]

## How It Works

Why The TV App is the easiest way to watch live TV online

🌐

### Runs Entirely in Your Browser

The TV App is a fully web-based platform. There is nothing to install, nothing to set up. Open
Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge, visit TheTVApp.stream, and you are watching live TV in seconds.

⚡

### No Signup, No Account Needed

TheTVApp never asks for your email, phone number, or payment details. The TV App is completely
anonymous - just visit the site and start streaming. No accounts, no forms, no tracking.

📱

### Works on Every Device

Android, iPhone, iPad, Windows, Mac, Linux, Smart TVs, Fire TV, Chromecast - if your device has a
browser, TheTVApp works on it. Your browser is your remote.

💰

### 100% Free Forever

No subscriptions. No hidden fees. No auto-renewing trials. The TV App is free, always has been, and
always will be. Every channel is available to every visitor at zero cost.

🌍

### Access From Anywhere

Whether you are in the United States, Europe, Asia, Africa, or the Middle East - The TV App is
available worldwide. Open TheTVApp.stream from any country with an internet connection.

🕒

### Live Streams 24/7

Channels on The TV App run around the clock. Late-night games, dawn news, afternoon movie marathons
- live TV is always on, always waiting for you on TheTVApp.

## Why Choose Free Streaming Over Cable

The real reasons The TV App is replacing cable TV for millions

Cable TV costs $50-150 per month, locks you into contracts, and ties you to a set-top box in one
room. **TheTVApp** flips that entirely - free live TV, every device, zero commitment.

💰

### Save $600+ Per Year on TV

The average cable bill is $80-120 per month. The TV App costs $0. That is over $1,000 per year back
in your pocket while still watching the same live channels.

📦

### Replace Multiple Subscriptions

Instead of paying for 4-5 streaming services, TheTVApp gives you live sports, news, movies, and kids
channels in one place. One tab, hundreds of channels.

⏱

### Start Watching Instantly

No technician visit. No equipment delivery. No setup wizard. Open TheTVApp.stream and you are
watching live TV within 10 seconds.
